# Elemental — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 34/3/14 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 80 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. No party fixture places a member on this spec yet. [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/shaman/elemental/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). No measured numbers for this spec: it has no row in the round-155 table, which lists the 14 specs with boss-fight data [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. ## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **SE00u-wizard-oil — Apply Brilliant Wizard Oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 144); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **SE00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Dreamshard Elixir (item 61224, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 45427 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 171); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **SE00u-greater-nature-power — Use Elixir of Greater Nature Power:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of Greater Nature Power (item 50237, required level 48), elixir or potion (aura 45988 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 173); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **SE00u-demonic-rune — Use Demonic Rune:** HO-TKB-PLAY-206 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18; ruling: a rule naming an item nobody holds is free): Demonic Rune (item 12662).
- **SE00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **SE00c-water-breathing-pre-swim — Water Breathing:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) every member enters with at least five minutes of Water Breathing: a buff placed for an earlier stretch ran out in the next one.
- **SE00b-water-breathing — Water Breathing:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): covered_by [5697, 1066] (v30): a member in Aquatic Form or carrying the other breath buff is skipped. The old Tremor Totem rule waits for `party.any_feared`, i.e. until the fear has landed; Tremor Totem pulses every 3 seconds and breaks a fear in progress, so a totem already down when he screams ends it at once.

His Sacrifice (22651) is a 1 s cast on a random member; a Grounding Totem eats one spell aimed at the party, so it is the cheap answer to a landed Sacrifice (a teleport, an 8 s stun and a 300 per second leech).
- **SE04-grounding-totem — Grounding Totem:** Free, 20 s recoveryTime, 45 s duration, an air totem that eats one spell aimed at the party. It is in the file because it has a cooldown to gate on; the buff totems the checklist tabulates are not, for the reason the note gives.
- **SE05-earthbind-totem — Earthbind Totem:** Free, 15 s recoveryTime, an earth totem that slows what is inside its radius.

The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.

Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **SE00t-searing-totem:** Flametongue Totem for a melee group needs a party-composition term (vocabulary v43, not on main): not built, the Searing Totem is the default.
